introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: At Advisable, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

dataWeCollect.title: Data We Collect
dataWeCollect.content: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you which we have grouped together as follows:
dataWeCollect.identityData: Identity Data: name, username or similar identifier
dataWeCollect.contactData: Contact Data: email address, telephone numbers
dataWeCollect.technicalData: Technical Data: internet protocol (IP) address, browser type and version, time zone setting and location, browser plug-in types and versions, operating system and platform, and other technology on the devices you use to access this website
dataWeCollect.usageData: Usage Data: information about how you use our website, products and services

howWeCollect.title: How We Collect Your Data
howWeCollect.content: We use different methods to collect data from and about you including through:
howWeCollect.directInteractions: Direct interactions: You may give us your Identity and Contact Data by filling in forms or by corresponding with us by post, phone, email or otherwise.
howWeCollect.automatedTechnologies: Automated technologies or interactions: As you interact with our website, we may automatically collect Technical Data about your equipment, browsing actions and patterns.

analytics.title: Analytics and Tracking Technologies
analytics.content: We use various analytics and tracking technologies to help analyze how users use our website. These technologies may collect information sent by your device or our website, including the web pages you visit, add-ons, and other information that assists us in improving our website.

googleAnalytics.title: Google Analytics
googleAnalytics.content: We use Google Analytics to help us understand how visitors engage with our website. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies to collect and analyze information about website use and report on activities and trends. This service may also collect information regarding the use of other websites, apps, and online resources.

googleTagManager.title: Google Tag Manager
googleTagManager.content: We use Google Tag Manager to manage various JavaScript and HTML tags used for tracking and analytics on our website. Google Tag Manager itself does not collect personal data, but it does help us deploy tags that may collect data.

microsoftClarity.title: Microsoft Clarity
microsoftClarity.content: We use Microsoft Clarity to obtain insights on how users interact with our website. This service helps us understand user behavior, such as where users click, how far they scroll, and time spent on specific pages. Microsoft Clarity may collect personal data such as IP address, device information, and browsing activity.

advertising.title: Advertising
advertising.content: We use Google Ads and Meta Ads (Facebook Advertising) to deliver targeted advertisements to you on other websites and platforms. These services use cookies and similar technologies to track your activity on our website and elsewhere on the internet to show you relevant advertisements.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Personal Data
howWeUse.content: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
howWeUse.contract: Where we need to perform the contract we are about to enter into or have entered into with you.
howWeUse.legitimateInterests: Where it is necessary for our legitimate interests (or those of a third party) and your interests and fundamental rights do not override those interests.
howWeUse.legalObligation: Where we need to comply with a legal obligation.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed. In addition, we limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We will only retain your personal data for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, regulatory, tax, accounting or reporting requirements.

legalRights.title: Your Legal Rights
legalRights.content: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, including the right to:
legalRights.access: Request access to your personal data
legalRights.correction: Request correction of your personal data
legalRights.erasure: Request erasure of your personal data
legalRights.object: Object to processing of your personal data
legalRights.restriction: Request restriction of processing your personal data
legalRights.transfer: Request transfer of your personal data

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.content: We may update our privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new privacy policy on this page.
